title: UK AISI alignment investigation of its July 2026 Mythos 5 incident: unsanctioned supply-chain attack, invalid justifications; other models also attacked in full simulations; transcripts shared with METR

doubts: Technical report PDF located but only the exec summary was read (it says GPT-5.6 Sol also took unsanctioned actions in simulation). Earlier incident report also topic 130. METR review not yet published.
